compiled_route(pathway, depth) is a pure function; all 12 (pathway, depth) cells match their pinned node/edge digest; the plan carries the verified build id and a run pinned to one build refuses execution under another.

Two compilations of every route are equal; the plan digest moves with set id/version and with the brief; two runs from the same pins share plan_digest; the digest is recomputed from the plan preimage and reasserted.

Structural proof - no test attempts a runtime graph mutation because no seam exists for one.

SOURCE_SET_EMPTY pauses the run at the entry gate with nothing pinned; resume over a still-empty set re-pauses; a parked run has zero provider contact and holds no admission slot.

A node's artifact is bound to run_id, case_id, module_id, input_fingerprint (plan_digest + route occurrence + upstream digests + source_set_digest), methodology build id, qa_status and provider identity (model/version), each rejected on relocation; the plan carries profile_id, build_id and the source set, and route occurrence ids are pinned per stage (RN-<profile>-<pathway>-<stage>-<module>). verify_artifact_content (the function Engine._upstream_digests calls before every module) rejects a forged input_fingerprint, run/case/module relocation and qa drift; a tampered plan fails digest reassertion; a forged upstream digest fails the run gate RUN_NOT_READY; a non-verifying artifact is never reused. Weak point: the mid-run invocation seam (AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH 'validated upstream artifact is unavailable') is proven through the shared verifier and the finalization gate, not by a test that forges an upstream digest between two modules.

No route carries a forward dependency and the executed node order equals the compiled route on every corpus route; missing blocking inputs are typed refusals: an absent CP-4C calculator record refuses the Distressed effect, an incomplete core calculation fails the run, an absent annual report refuses at the source gate, and a failed sibling leaves dependants pending/cancelled, never running.

An incomplete non-core calculator is absent from the pinned records and present in host-derived calculation_limitations / limitation_flags; a missing forecast driver is UNAVAILABLE with a gap code; stale marks, a missing workbook, a missing base model and screen depth are named limitations or typed preconditions, never silent defaults.

Reuse-first recovery relinks the committed artifact: one artifact and one charge after a commit-gap crash; finished modules keep their (module, digest) pairs with execution count 1 and budget turns == provider calls (zero calls for the reused modules); the succeeded node follows the artifact id it is linked to.

find_valid_artifact returns None when the stored digest, the provider identity or the fingerprint no longer verifies; invalid or unbounded payloads are refused at completion; a reuse relink re-checks live sources and fails on a withdrawal; a changed or missing agent identity is refused before provider contact.

A fresh Engine over the same checkpoint database recovers and completes without re-executing finished modules; the research gate survives restart; on the built image a hard kill of app and worker was followed by health in 11 s with recovery.started over 6 runs and identical row counts before and after.
Execution count of every finished module stays 1 across a restart, across a restart loop of one kill per module, and even when the checkpoint file is absent.
run.succeeded appears exactly once; a failed resume ends with exactly [run.failed]; a dying final validation commits no success and the retry commits it once; a breaching commit never lands.

Event ids are a per-run monotonic, gap-free seq allocated under the run-row lock on PostgreSQL, ordered by seq not by clock, durable past checkpoint deletion and resumable by id. Scope: the seq is per run and the run is case-bound; the events route resolves run -> case -> membership (same 404 for unknown and foreign runs; 59 routes x 9 actors, 0 failures).
A reconnect with Last-Event-ID = the penultimate id receives exactly the final frame and nothing before it; a fully delivered terminal tail closes; events_after(last) is empty.
An hour parked at the entry-gate interrupt under a fake clock accrues active_minutes == 0. Proven on the source-set gate; the Deep Research plan-approval wait is not separately asserted.

Every loop step (count, create, evidence read, parse/validate, reuse validation, completion write, final verification) is inside a timed bracket; throwing host operations and slow validation are charged to active_minutes; actual provider usage is committed to tokens even when it breaches; a truncation never consumes the repair while a real repair does; evidence reads are charged to evidence_reads/bytes; a lost response is on the ledger exactly once.

A failed reservation ends the run AGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with zero provider requests; each of the six dimensions refuses the next operation with used <= limit; two PostgreSQL writers get one reservation and one typed refusal.
A persisted in-flight digest with unknown spend fails the resumed run AGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with the provider call count unchanged and the digest retained as the record of the unknown.

Active jobs (20, in-process and over HTTP with ADMISSION_BUSY), streams (4) and previews (2) per subject, tool calls (evidence reads per module and per run, refs per module), retry (one byte-identical timeout retry then AGENT_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT), repair (one), tokens (input/output ceilings, per-module output caps, truncation), artifact size/shape and active time are each refused at/above their ceiling. The 32 MiB request ceiling is Caddy's and was NOT_EXERCISED over HTTP (no --edge-url).
